changes: Homepage combines owned root docs/folders with directly shared docs/folders; descendants remain inside shared folders and existing role checks are preserved.
Selection checkboxes appear on hover/focus or during selection; bulk controls appear only after selection. Cmd/Ctrl-click toggles, Shift-click selects a range, and row-menu selection supports touch.
Previous/next controls cycle document tabs. Alt+PageUp/PageDown works from the editor; Mac hover hints show Option+Fn+Up/Down. Existing text-selection shortcuts are preserved.
